name: Thyroid Gland Mucosa-Associated Lymphoid Tissue Lymphoma
description: An extranodal marginal zone B-cell lymphoma arising from mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue in the thyroid gland. The vast majority of cases are associated with chronic lymphocytic thyroiditis.
